frontmatter.name: deep-query-optimizer
frontmatter.description: SQL member of the deep-optimizer family: a multi-pass review-and-fix optimizer for a SQL query or file. Detects the dialect (Postgres/MySQL/SQLite/SQL Server), audits sargability, indexes, joins and N+1, predicates, pagination, subqueries/CTEs and the EXPLAIN plan; severity-rates findings; applies every Medium+ rewrite; and given a DB connection, verifies via EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE that the plan improved and the result set is unchanged, backing out regressions and looping to convergence. Recommends index DDL. TRIGGER: "optimize this SQL", "run dqo", "tune this query", "why is this query slow", "what index for this query", full-scan/N+1/deep-paging SQL. SKIP: evals -> deep-eval-optimizer; MongoDB/MQL → deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer (/dmqo); warehouse/dbt or SQL schema modeling → da-data-engineering-platform; ORM or app-layer N+1 in code → code-deep-optimizer; one-shot advice with no query → software-engineering-patterns; prose → ddo; prompts → prompt-deep-optimizer.

frontmatter.name: deep-query-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Review and tune a concrete SQL query or file while preserving its results. TRIGGER: "optimize this SQL", "run dqo", "tune this query", "why is this SQL slow", "what index serves this query". Covers Postgres/MySQL/SQLite/SQL Server, sargability, indexes, joins/N+1, predicates, pagination, CTEs and EXPLAIN. Apply Medium+ only in permitted write mode; verify plans and result semantics when a safe connection exists, back out regressions, recommend index DDL. SKIP: evals → deep-eval-optimizer; MongoDB/MQL → deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer; warehouse/dbt/schema modeling → da-data-engineering-platform; ORM/app N+1 → code-deep-optimizer; advice without a query → software-engineering-patterns; prose → ddo; prompts → prompt-deep-optimizer.
